title: Expensive and poorly designed
text:
Expensive and poorly designed. This is so cheaply made. It’s not real glass. It’s not real wood. The faux wood paper it is wrapped in was poorly designed. The paper goes over the back plate. So, to put my picture in, I literally had to rip up the paper on the back (see photos). So frustrating.

I would rank it higher if the price point matched but this was expensive for something so cheap.
